stories.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
stories.body: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.

stories.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
stories.body: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

stories.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
stories.body: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

stories.title: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
stories.body: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

stories.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
stories.body: Front-runner Carmelle emerges victorious with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra.

stories.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
stories.body: Sotheby's says it will work with the heirs of a family who had previously owned the artwork to try and reach a solution.

stories.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
stories.body: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

stories.title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever
stories.body: The 52-year-old general’s provocative posts and military threats have fuelled rumours of a dynastic succession.

stories.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
stories.body: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

stories.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
stories.body: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

stories.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
stories.body: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.

stories.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
stories.body: Efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot are complete, the tech firm says.

stories.title: 'We'll get home one day' - US travellers impacted by nationwide ground stop
stories.body: Passengers throughout the country were impacted over what the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) describes as “safety and communication issues”.

stories.title: Watch: Cruise ship overturns after collision with tanker in New Orleans
stories.body: Around 130 people were rescued from a cruise ship after it was struck by a tanker while docked in New Orleans, Louisiana on Friday.

stories.title: Watch: Divers explore US ship sunk off Florida coast to create new reef
stories.body: The ship was intentionally sunk off the coast of Florida in order to create the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

stories.title: Will the Eurovision Song Contest succeed in Asia?
stories.body: The world’s biggest and longest-running song contest is coming to Asia, with eleven countries competing in Bangkok, Thailand on Saturday.

stories.title: Military cemetery decorum: The tradition behind Hegseth's Veterans Day reprimand
stories.body: BBC's Bernd Debusmann breaks down why Defence Secretary Hegseth's group was reprimanded at Arlington National Cemetery and the history behind its strict rules of conduct.

stories.title: 'We've got to run': Inside ruined Ukraine power plant under constant drone threat
stories.body: Dan Johnson visits one of the country's largest power stations, barely left standing after a ballistic missile strike by Russia.

stories.title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos
stories.body: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.

stories.title: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
stories.body: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.
